goal: Produce an evidence-backed product, recruitment, and explanatory substrate for Whisper and later Invoke Design/Plan to create one browser-native Co-Op Engine page that is itself the live presentation, recruits collaborators, explains every named project honestly, and supports the 45-minute weekly meeting; also determine whether the portfolio-showcase mechanism is the right collaboration model.
context: The Co-Op Engine is a weekly 45-minute sync where people bring a project, offer a skill, or listen and discover collaboration. The eventual artifact is one browser-native page, not a separate webpage and slide deck: it must work as a self-guided recruitment/explanation page and as the projected live presentation, while keeping audience-visible copy, presenter-only notes, interaction prompts, and authoring metadata separated inside the same artifact. The target public is capable makers: technical people who should not need internal framework jargon, plus domain practitioners such as writers and musicians who understand their craft, want to work with AI, and aspire to build their own tools; technical terms must be earned through concrete examples. The Veritasium preset is a candidate explanatory movement—misconception, dissonance, reveal, concrete instrument, honest boundary, zoom-out—inside Whisper's live-presentation transport, not a substitute for its operator voice gate or a license to imitate a brand. This dispatch stops at cited research substrate and acceptance contracts: project truth cards, product hypotheses, alternative meeting models, Whisper intake fields, claim ceilings, a shared human/machine content model, a black-box browser-test specification, a conversational-AI/chat-language and copy audit specification, and an ease-of-understanding/coherence audit with human retellability residue. The named corpus spans Whisper, User Guide, Agentic Music Studio, Poker Agent Arena, Body War, UI Prototyping Studio, Tower System Taxonomy, IDE Extension, IDE Ergonomics, X-Ray, Arcanum Journey, Autoads, Sonar Loop, and Ontologize; private project evidence must remain in the private parent workspace, while any later reusable Arcanum derivative must be scrubbed and owner-routed.

groups.anti_bias: attack-vector: precedent versus non-vacuity versus definitional-soundness

agents.angle: precedent gate that finds actual owners for each collaboration mechanism and labels build-from-owned versus genuinely unowned combinations
agents.initial_prompt: Attack only the precedent gate. Verify actual owners for the proposed Co-Op mechanisms, product patterns, knowledge-graph writing precedents, unified webpage/presentation conventions, recruitment explainers, Veritasium-style explanatory moves, browser black-box validation patterns, and copy/comprehension audit methods. Being owned is not a KILL: label build-from-owned or already-deployed; an independently evidenced empty search may label precedent-clean. Check whether the synthesizer reused the existing internal investor-portfolio, simple-ontology-presentation, Craft teaching browser-validation, conversational-language, and readability findings rather than claiming novelty. Pair predictions on the attack-vector axis: Popper runs precedent ownership while Taleb runs concrete witness construction; Popper's ownership bias is exposed if Taleb shows a useful locally testable combination regardless of precedent. Popper runs precedent ownership while Quine runs definitional collapse; Popper's source-match bias is exposed if Quine shows the proposal is merely a renamed local concept. Taleb runs concrete witness construction while Quine runs definitional collapse; Taleb's demo bias is exposed if Quine shows the witness proves only a relabelled mechanism.

Popper runs precedent ownership while Quine runs definitional collapse; Popper's source-match bias is exposed if Quine shows the proposal is merely a renamed local concept. Taleb runs concrete witness construction while Quine runs definitional collapse; Taleb's demo bias is exposed if Quine shows the witness proves only a relabelled mechanism.

agents.angle: definitional-soundness gate that rejects renamed portfolios, generic pitch decks, vague agentic labels, and knowledge-graph metaphors without typed relations
agents.initial_prompt: Attack only the definitional-soundness gate. Test whether each supposedly new mechanism collapses to a portfolio, directory, demo day, kanban board, talent marketplace, matchmaking session, generic knowledge graph, slide deck embedded in a page, or ordinary responsive website with renamed modes. Pair predictions on the attack-vector axis: Popper runs precedent ownership while Taleb runs concrete witness construction; Popper's ownership bias is exposed if Taleb shows a useful locally testable combination regardless of precedent. Popper runs precedent ownership while Quine runs definitional collapse; Popper's source-match bias is exposed if Quine shows the proposal is merely a renamed local concept. Taleb runs concrete witness construction while Quine runs definitional collapse; Taleb's demo bias is exposed if Quine shows the witness proves only a relabelled mechanism.
